title: A Bounded Degree SOS Plus SONC Hierarchy for Polynomial Optimization
summary: We propose a bounded degree SOS+SONC hierarchy for constrained polynomial optimization, termed B-SOS+SONC. Starting from Lasserre's bounded-degree SOS framework, we enlarge the certificate cone from SOS to the recently introduced SOS+SONC cone, thereby combining the algebraic strength of semidefinite relaxations with the sparse structure captured by circuit polynomials. We show that, for each fixed certificate degree, the resulting hierarchy is complete, that is, its optimal values are monotone and converge to the global optimum.
